title: Sync and Patch Dependencies
body:
Vulnerabilities found during daily sync:
GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx (qs): array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing
GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g (qs): Denial of Service via Attacker Controlled isBuffer
GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr (joi): Prototype pollution via a `__proto__` language key in custom messages
GHSA-gg4h-3hg2-grpc (joi): object().rename() with a template target can set the validated object's prototype
GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh (js-yaml): maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
GHSA-gqvv-2mrq-wpjv (hono): Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-39408: `toSSG()` still writes files outside the output directory
GHSA-g6gw-c38x-mqfc (hono): Unbounded dot-notation nesting in `parseBody()` can cause memory exhaustion
GHSA-crvj-82cr-hjcx (hono): Query parser reads parameters after the URL fragment, causing cache-key and proxy interpretation differentials
Patching qs to >=6.16.0, joi to >=18.2.5, js-yaml to >=4.3.2, hono to >=4.13.5.
